create.name: Eluña Noelle
create.bio:
Psychology, ancient wisdom, mythology, consciousness and intuitive practice all meet in the work of Eluña Noelle, a psycho-spiritual teacher who says she has had heightened intuitive awareness since early childhood. Starting college at sixteen, she took pre-medical courses at the University of Washington, then moved to The Evergreen State College to study psychology, human development and transpersonal psychology. Afterwards she gained a master's in Montessori education and became a certified Psychosynthesis life coach. She first read the Akashic Records privately for friends and clients; since her first public channelling, in January 2024, her online following has grown large.

Her teaching moves between study and direct experience, drawing on meditation, breathwork, guided writing, voice, contemplation and embodiment, and gives particular weight to the mystery traditions and the archetypes of ancient Egypt. She leads The Circle, an online membership with live teachings and monthly meditations, as well as a year-long Living Mystery School, and her self-paced courses include one on accessing the Akashic Records. She teaches retreats at the Art of Living Retreat Center and Omega Institute and guides sacred journeys in Egypt. In late 2026 she announced that she is stepping back from trance channelling to focus on teaching.

courses.title: Through the Heart to the Akashic Records
courses.description: An eight-week self-paced course of 74 lessons on building your own relationship with the Akashic field. It combines teaching, meditation, practice and downloadable materials, with lifetime access.

courses.title: The Living Mystery School
courses.description: Eluña's year-long online school on consciousness, ancient wisdom, archetype and the inner path, with live gatherings, ceremonies and a library of earlier teachings. New students can join the final cycle, which runs to February 2027.

courses.title: The Circle
courses.description: An online membership community with a monthly live guided meditation, a monthly energy update with Q&A, live channelling sessions, guest lectures and a library of more than 100 hours. First month $11, or $222 a year.

courses.title: Alchemical Awakening Mystery School (Art of Living Retreat Center)
courses.description: A five-day residential retreat in the Blue Ridge Mountains of North Carolina, with esoteric teachings, ancient creation stories, breathwork, guided writing, psychic skill-building and daily ceremony. Tuition is added to a lodging and meals package.
courses.price: From $450 USD tuition (lodging and meals from $1,232 USD extra)

courses.title: The Art of Mastery: Sacred Initiation, Egypt 2027
courses.description: An 18-day journey on the Nile and at Egypt's temples for those completing the Living Mystery School, with teaching, ceremony and rites of passage. Places are by application and limited to 36.

courses.title: Sobek and Horus: Magi of Shadow & Light
courses.description: A self-paced archetypal study using the Egyptian figures of Sobek and Horus to work with the shadow and hold light and dark together. Includes the Horus foundations course and lifetime access.

courses.title: Sekhmet: High Priestess of Will, the Word, & Integrity
courses.description: A self-paced archetypal study with Sekhmet, exploring will, speech and integrity through teachings on the sacred fire and the origins of ancient civilisation. Lifetime access.

courses.title: The Heart Alchemist: Forgiveness, Wholeness, & Creation
courses.description: A self-paced archetypal study on forgiveness, wholeness and creation, including the Electric Body Mountain meditation and teachings on the four aspects of speech. Lifetime access.

courses.title: The Sacred Trinity — Voice, Embodiment, & Rebirth
courses.description: A self-paced archetypal study on voice, embodiment and rebirth, with teachings and a guided meditation on the frequency of creation. Lifetime access.

courses.title: Self-Activation & Embodiment
courses.description: A recorded two-hour experiential workshop on presence, breath, stillness and embodied practice. It teaches simple ways to work with your own energy.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube 74K (@elunanoelle channel page, 30 Oct 2026); Instagram 15K (@elunanoelle og:description); no Facebook, X or TikTok linked from her site → ~89K total → local_hero
flags: Tier borderline: ~89K total (80k–150k band). YouTube is growing fast (latest video 122K views in two days), so she may pass 100K soon.
Email: media@elunanoelle.com (media, interviews and collaborations) used; support@elunanoelle.com (membership support) and retreats@elunanoelle.com (Egypt page) are also published.
Around 28 Oct 2026 she published 'Why I'm Walking Away From Channeling', and her site now calls her a psycho-spiritual teacher, so 'channelled-teachings' as a subject may soon be out of date.
Shift Network profile lists only a 'New Program With Eluna Noelle' starting December 2026, with no course page yet; add it once a URL exists.
Art of Living retreat page frames emotional 'pain' as something to alchemise and lists medical contraindications; kept, as it names no condition.
Egypt 2027 initiation is open by application to those completing the Living Mystery School.
Living Mystery School final cycle ends February 2027 (no exact end date published); remove after that.
